_note: Appendix-C engineering metadata (R4) — the SMALL curated attribute set that helps a reader organize the catalogue without bloating the equal-sized brick. Two curated facts live here: `primary_concern` (the cross-cutting organizer shown as the second brick chip; each cross-walks 1:1 to a GEE capability in catalogue-classification.json so the chip adopts an existing schema rather than inventing one) and `domain_specific` (the ~10 document-accessibility instances whose transferable unit is the TECHNIQUE they instantiate, not the mechanism — surfaced as a louder instance backref). Everything else is DERIVED at build time, NOT stored here: enforcement from the entry card Enf. row (book/build_book.py:_note_enforcement_map), applicability from brick-applicability.json, and kind / abstract_name / parent_technique / advanced_examples from catalogue-classification.json's dispositions (the keep-as-L2 / demote-to-L3 axis). Consumed by book/build_book.py:_load_primary_concern() + _load_domain_specific(); the drift lint book-models/lint_brick_metadata.py asserts every catalogue slug appears here AND in brick-applicability.json. Vocabulary uses 'structured', not 'typed'. Source: book/_design/drafts/appendix-c-feedback/ (engineering-metadata-DRAFT.json + technique-vs-mechanism.md).

_primary_concern_vocabulary._kind: closed, reader-facing set of 9 concerns; each cross-walks 1:1 to a GEE capability in catalogue-classification.json (the repo's own concern taxonomy) so the chip adopts an existing schema rather than inventing one; per-entry assignment is CURATED judgment, not the parent L2 capability copied verbatim

Context.gloss: deliver the right rules and knowledge to the actor at the point of action

Admission.gloss: gate the work order and the path to production

Orchestration.gloss: manage fleet work, state, resources, and lifecycle

Modeling.gloss: represent the system as authoritative structured models the fleet reasons through

Synchronization.gloss: keep the models equal to the code and system they describe

Validation.gloss: check output conforms and establish completion on re-derived evidence

Provenance.gloss: durably attribute every mutation and trace its cause

Constraint.gloss: confine mutation to sanctioned surfaces and closed action vocabularies
